desc:
Feed the Ants is a cosy idle game: drop food into your glass terrarium and watch your ant colony carry it home, one crumb at a time.

🍩 Every food is taken apart piece by piece, from a sugar cube to a giant trophy
🐜 Spend the coins they earn on more workers, more speed and more strength
🏠 Watch the nest grow: new chambers, a queen with her brood, a larder that fills up
🌍 Ten worlds to eat through, from the sandbox to the Moon
💤 Your colony keeps earning while you are away
👀 Six terrariums in one room: walk over and watch what your friends are feeding theirs
😌 No timer, no losing, nothing to rush. A game to zone out to.

Read what's new in our community: One Crumb at a Time
